THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / OCTOBER 2026
PORTRAITS & LIGHT
017
STUDY 004
Studio Ponytail Portrait
Rights check
Source: 4571.jpg
Poised, graphic, monochrome
WORKING NOTES
- Strong choice for hair care campaigns or lookbooks.
- The diagonal ponytail is the key compositional element.
Try this: Emphasize the diagonal ponytail.
IMAGE PROMPT
A minimalist studio portrait of an original young
woman against a pale gray-white seamless
backdrop, framed vertically and cropped from
mid-torso up. Her long, straight black hair is swept
back from her face and pulled to one side in a low,
sleek ponytail that falls past her shoulder and down
her chest, with loose strands framing her temples.
She wears a fitted black strapless top, with bare
shoulders and arms. Natural makeup with soft
pink-brown lips, and a calm, direct gaze toward the
camera. Soft, even studio lighting with gentle
shadows along the jaw and collarbone, a
monochrome palette of soft grays, white, and deep
black, warm-neutral skin tones. The long ponytail
creates a strong diagonal line down the right side of
the frame. Poised, editorial, and graphic, in the
style of a hair care or minimalist fashion lookbook.
